title: 3.2.0.1 new APK res/q-.apk duplicates many files in res/
symptom: The new APK (3.2.0.1) contains a res/q-.apk that duplicates many files in the res/ directory, more than doubling the disk size of the res directory and increasing the APK size from 55 MB to 66.2 MB compared to 3.2.0-rc2.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It is speculated that the change might be related to migration to kts builds, but no concrete cause is identified.
evidence_quote: the change between rc2 and 3.2.0.1 is migration to kts builds. maybe there is something different. but i didn't find a option how to affect it
